scope: Stage 6b correction (D30, D32): single-q strong constraint of the Luttinger-Tisza diagnostic at quarter wave vectors.
defect: For every q* with 2q* not a reciprocal vector the fit required u_a . u_a = 0 (a spiral). When 4q* is a reciprocal vector but 2q* is not, the phases exp(2 i q* . R) are only +-1, and |n_a(R)|^2 = |u_a|^2/2 + Re[(u_a . u_a) exp(2 i q* . R)]/2 requires only Re(u_a . u_a) = 0 and |u_a|^2 = 2. Non-spiral single-q states such as up-up-down-down were rejected (false negative).
found_by: Derivation for the Luttinger-Tisza theory appendix (docs/lswt/04-appendices/luttinger-tisza-method.md, 2026-09-30).

change.code-space/spintoolkit/methods/luttinger: _phase_case(fraction) -> 'real' (2q* in G), 'quarter' (4q* in G, 2q* not), 'generic'; _strong_fit uses Re(u.u) for 'quarter'; module docstring states the three cases. Interface unchanged.

reproduction.model: square lattice, S = 1/2; second-neighbour (2, 0) Ising-like AFM diag(0.2, 0.2, 1); (0, 1) FM -diag(0.2, 0.2, 1)
reproduction.after: strong_constraint True, state_energy -0.5 (bound reached), directions +z, +z, -z, -z along a1 (uudd)

findings: The corrected fit accepts the uudd state, whose classical energy equals lambda_min.
The stage 6b benchmark report (square FM/Neel, triangular, J1-J2, honeycomb FM + DM, Kitaev, NBCP XXZ) is identical before and after, apart from timings.
Full suite: 496 passed (495 before plus the new test).
Package regression snapshot: 144 leaves compared, maximum difference 0.0.
